observations: Blue plastic toy piano with five keys.
Keys feature characters from the 'Bluey' animated series.
Large circular button with 'Bluey' logo on the top right.
Orange carry handle attached to the side.
Mode selection slider switch on the front panel.
Battery compartment on the back secured with a screw.
Printed text on battery cover: 'BAM code: 431018' and 'Batch code: 100X4'.
